description: This file defines types and functions for creating and resolving inbound envelope routes and formatting in a messaging or communication system. It includes functions for building envelope formatters, resolving routes, and runtime helpers for inbound envelope processing.

methods.name: createInboundEnvelopeBuilder
methods.description: Creates an envelope formatter bound to a specific route and session store, returning a function to format envelopes.

methods.name: resolveInboundRouteEnvelopeBuilder
methods.description: Resolves a route and returns both the route and a builder for envelope formatting.

methods.name: resolveInboundRouteEnvelopeBuilderWithRuntime
methods.description: Provides a runtime-driven variant for resolving inbound routes and envelope builders, suitable for plugins with grouped helpers.
